theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ : ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < r₀ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : Euclid P => (!₂[‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x u)] : Euclid 2)) {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x u} ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P, fderiv ℝ (fun x : Euclid P => (!₂[‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x u)] : Euclid 2)) (r₀ • u) h = !₂[inner ℝ u h, inner ℝ e h / r₀]
